ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity dominance; roughly 85-90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) clusters at lateral extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive dark pigmentation across the central and medial surfaces. Fine-grained grey mottling on the lower inner lobes. Distinct high-density dark focal spots visible on the right lobe mid-section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated acute angle of approximately 40 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations (sawtooth pattern) along the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature initiating from the median notch, transitioning to a steep outward lateral sweep terminating at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-vertical parallel linear tracks (rake marks) on the medial portion of the right lobe; several smaller horizontal scratches on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent tooth-rake scarring on the right lobe; heavy encrustation (likely barnacles) causing textural deformation at the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular lesion or pigmentation spot located in the mid-region of the left lobe.
